## User-granted final representative approval — exact v7 subject

Recording the user's explicit **“Approve exact subject (Recommended)”** decision,
relayed by the parent after its independent Spec review. This records the user's
approval; it is **not an autonomous approval decision by the coding agent**.

Approved case: `representative.stage4-frames-text-assets.v7`

Candidate: `tests/conformance/candidates/stage4-frames-text-assets-v7/`

Approved canonical subject:

```text
sha256:c314cff42bdaac7fae932c4e7e4c8a9dc278b69a7077d9e4de37bc5cddf2fa05
```

This approval includes exactly the three case-specific PDF exceptions bound in
that subject, for variant `default` and their exact pinned viewer profiles:

| Comparison / region | Bounds `[x,y,width,height]` | Maximum changed pixels | Minimum SSIM bits |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| PDFium / whole | `[0,0,200,120]` | 118 | `3fefacd49b980278` |
| PDFium / typography | `[10,12,124,41]` | 118 | `3fee1f978eeaac28` |
| PDF.js / whole | `[0,0,200,120]` | 16 | `3feff3e226be27cf` |

The approved subject binds the final release producer, fixed authoring/request/
crops, all collected evidence and reports, the exact current-PDF typography
colour-space bridge, diagnosis, semantic checks and scoped limits. PDF.js
typography passes canonically and has no exception. Global budgets are unchanged.

The parent reports independent recomputation of the subject and verification of
493 descriptors with no stale bindings. The parent explicitly authorized recording
this approval, running the approved three-format release consumer, and recording
the strict representative owner for `interaction:frames-text-assets`.

This is a scoped representative approval. It does not approve the global
ownership ledger or release closure, refresh the native baseline tracked in
#178, or close the pre-existing fixed-size moxcms allocation/resource gap. The
earlier protected PDF pin approval remains a separate, unchanged decision.

Capture and review details: `docs/research/png-stage4-v7-release-capture.md`.
